post_c1.intent: deterministic high-confidence route is authoritative; otherwise LLM-owned

post_c1.target_repositories: deterministic explicit/legacy/reviewed signals plus valid LLM repository output
post_c1.resolved_versions: deterministic fixed-version mapping after merged repository scope
post_c1.requested_versions: deterministic explicit SHA for named repositories overrides; unresolved values remain LLM-owned
post_c1.symbols: LLM-owned semantic symbols plus deterministic reviewed-expansion symbols
post_c1.concepts: LLM-owned semantic concepts plus deterministic reviewed-expansion concepts
post_c1.concept_scopes: deterministic recognized scopes override LLM scopes; unresolved scopes remain LLM-owned
post_c1.resolved_aliases: deterministic accepted-alias lookup with review-status provenance
post_c1.paper_page_hints: deterministic reviewed-expansion hints, then existing intent filtering
post_c1.provenance: deterministic per-field lists of source/rule/value entries
post_c1.unresolved_fields: explicit analyzer-required fields passed in deterministic_context
post_c1.analyzer_final: merged diagnostic showing deterministic and LLM-owned final values
post_c1.source_budgets: policy selected from the authoritative final intent
post_c1.required_source_types: policy selected from the authoritative final intent
